records.binding_boundary: 원binding human/domain제약AND와weight/optional그대로읽음. source의 garment_detail 사실과 다른 기존wardrobe_style이면 finalrole/binding을따로직접검토; 자동role교체0.

exact_top_delta.after: Apply the specified curved cup-seam division and lower-bodice connection to the independently declared existing selected top, belonging to the originally declared existing main_subject wearer. Retain that top and wearer identity; do not introduce a garment, person or anatomical region. The curved seams divide that same top front and the cup lower boundaries join its continuous lower bodice as garment construction effects. Existing top/wearer identity is an independent prerequisite, not a requirement that these new seam/connection values already hold. Do not add padding, boning, anatomical breast form, fit, material identity or exposure from the fashion lookup label.

records.formal_ready_scope: 원문 의미가 비교적명료해 root직독후 새immutable input/formal native authoring 대상으로 제안한다는 뜻. proof완성/validator통과/승인 뜻 아님.
records.manual_reason: 원문 두개 구조clause가명료하며 top하나의내부구조 효과로분리할수있음. 각부분을가상별owner로추가하거나 착용자인체E로바꿀필요없음. 기존 top-only 적용은명시editorialapplication restriction이며원문에서모든possiblecreation경로를배제했다고주장하지않음.

Set small gathers in the blouse bust region above its horizontal seam, with the gathers converging toward that same lower bodice seam; set the stated flutter sleeve form and its continuation from the same blouse shoulder openings. The existing blouse carrier is an independent prerequisite, not a requirement that these new gathers or sleeves already hold. Do not introduce a new garment or person, or infer a milkmaid occupation, fabric identity, body size or extra fasteners.
